mainText: <speak><voice name="Kendra">Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 74 degrees with a feels-like temperature of 76 under overcast skies at Harriet Park, and we have a full moon out tonight.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Salli">The City Clerk is looking for student designs for an I Voted sticker, and the Verona Senior Center is now offering rides on their tri-shaw bike along the Military Ridge State Trail for those who sign the liability waiver.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Matthew">We have plenty of fun ahead with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both taking place today, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market tomorrow.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Justin">Looking at the police report from the past week, on July 21, a Verona Police Department drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating someone who had fled from a residence.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Joanna">The delicious flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The shop is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.</voice></speak>
